jd.title: Senior Product Manager — Visa Token Service (VTS)
jd.description: Visa is hiring a Senior PM to drive the Visa Token Service (VTS) tokenization product line — provisioning, lifecycle, and credential-on-file scenarios. You will define APIs and SDKs used by issuers, wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay), and large merchant card-on-file environments. Partner with cryptography, risk, and acceptance teams to launch new token formats and 3DS 2.x flows. Requirements: 6+ years PM, payments network or large-issuer experience, fluency in EMVCo / PCI / 3DS specs, ability to ship globally across regulated regions.

notes: Placeholder golden. Tokenization specs are highly cited — golden resume should be exact about which spec versions the candidate has shipped against.
